name: Visa割bot
tagline: Plays every unused Visa Japan offer draw so no free entry expires
description: Visa's Japanese offers programme includes lottery and roulette entries that go unclaimed because nobody remembers them before they lapse. Inside your own signed-in offers account, it steps through whichever draws are still open, enters each one, and reports what it played. No card details move and nothing is bought.
author: countertek
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
